MeasurementToolMetadata.Description: Body height, body weight and segment lengths of both arms, measured once per participant. Height is rounded to 10 mm and weight to 1 kg to reduce the risk of re-identification (quasi-identifier); lengths are whole mm.

height.Description: Body height, rounded to the nearest 10 mm to reduce the risk of re-identification (quasi-identifier). n/a when not recorded or outside the plausible range 800-2000 mm (data-entry error).

weight.Description: Body weight, rounded to the nearest 1 kg to reduce the risk of re-identification (quasi-identifier).
